menu_identity.title_seen: XNU ENTRY PROBE 02 - BLUE YELLOW MAGENTA CYAN WHITE

bands_observed_top_to_bottom.conclusion: XNU __start branch and diagnostic entry executed
BCM2837-only write suppressed, reached the SCTLR value build
msr sctlr_el1 executed, the original isb replayed, and the band was drawn through the diagnostic 1 GiB device mapping with the MMU on
_arm_init reached at the KVA: TTBR1 translation and instruction fetch work, control entered C

red_band_caveat: The early fault vectors are only reachable through the physical VBAR; after the MMU switch VBAR is the kernel KVA vectors, so the absence of red does not exclude a later exception

later_state.observed: the firmware menu is drawn again with its own countdown over the same framebuffer
later_state.means: the kernel did not reach iOS; control returned to the firmware (return or reset) after arm_init
later_state.not_proven: which function inside arm_init/arm_vm_init stopped it

loader_log_lines_read: Exiting boot services. A green bar across the top means the kernel entry code ran.
